Effect

Autopsy can see how other players died. It is incompatible with Doctor, Tracefinder, ScientistTOHE, and Sunnyboy. If the global setting already shows death reasons to everyone, Autopsy is not assigned randomly.

Settings

  • Max: Maximum number that can appear in one match.
  • Spawn Chance: Chance for a player to receive this add-on.
  • Eligibility: Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.
